new_libraries.name: PCMD3180
new_libraries.author: Magne Lauritzen <mag.lauritzen@gmail.com>
new_libraries.sentence: Arduino driver for Texas Instruments PCMD3180 8-channel PDM to TDM/I2S converter
new_libraries.paragraph: Control over I2C or SPI. Supports 8-channel PDM microphone input, TDM/I2S/LJ output in master or slave mode, digital volume, gain and phase calibration, decimation filter modes, high-pass, biquad and mixer coefficients, and GPIO/interrupt configuration.
